import io
from urllib3.response import HTTPResponse

# Create a minimal HTTPResponse object
fp = io.BytesIO(b"test data")
headers = {"Content-Type": "text/plain"}
resp = HTTPResponse(body=fp, headers=headers, preload_content=False)

# Use headers.get() instead of getheader() method
result = resp.headers.get("X-Missing", "default_value")
assert result == "default_value"

# Create a minimal HTTPResponse object
fp = io.BytesIO(b"test data")
headers = {"Content-Type": "text/plain", "Content-Length": "9"}
